method: threshold_in = the 10th percentile of the NOAA MRMS daily radar total (Iowa Environmental Mesonet point service) at the operator's median outfall point on the days its reported combined sewer discharges began (the larger of that day's total and the day before's), from `since` (the first full year of the operational MRMS product), when at least min_days of those days had radar rain (0.01 inch or more); days under 0.01 inch are counted, not sampled. Merged into data/build/rain-thresholds.json every hour by build().
radar_source: NOAA MRMS daily totals via the Iowa Environmental Mesonet reanalysis point service (mesonet.agron.iastate.edu/iemre), Central Standard Time days
